items.difficulty_reason: The lemma rewrites the vanishing of a finite tensor sum, along chosen generating sets of M and N, as the existence of a coefficient matrix satisfying two systems of relations (statement lines 26239-26258). The proof does not work with the universal property of the tensor product directly: it presents N as a quotient of a direct sum of copies of the ring by a kernel K, tensors the presentation with M using right exactness, lifts the given element to K tensor M, and then reads the entries of the lifted elements as the required coefficients (proof lines 26260-26275). Deciding to present N and then lift is the substance, and the author records both systems of relations exactly as they come out. H2.
